<?php

use Modules\AI\Domain\Decision\CandidateActionFactory;
use Modules\AI\Domain\Decision\RaidPlanner;
use Modules\AI\Domain\Perception\PlayerPerceptionBuilder;
use Modules\AI\Enums\AiArchetype;
use Modules\AI\Tests\Support\Situation;
use Tests\IsolatedAccountTestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../Support/Situation.php';

uses(IsolatedAccountTestCase::class);

// LIFE-001: an experienced player also hits a target that fights back when the odds and the haul are
// good — the battle then has combat rounds and leaves debris. The account plants a stocked, combat-ready
// fleet beside an inactive neighbour that stands a real wall, and must fly an Attack at it. The
// defenceless neighbour is the zero case: the same rule, no wall.

test('a stocked account flies a fight against a defended neighbour', function (): void {
    $situation = Situation::of($this)
        ->archetype(AiArchetype::Miner)
        ->resources(2_000_000, 2_000_000, 2_000_000)
        ->ships('large_cargo', 20)
        ->ships('light_fighter', 60)
        ->inactiveNeighbour(metal: 500_000, crystal: 300_000)
        ->neighbourUnits('rocket_launcher', 10)
        ->spyReport();

    $reportId = (int) \OGame\Models\EspionageReport::query()->orderByDesc('id')->value('id');
    $plan = app(RaidPlanner::class)->plan($this->currentUserId, $reportId);
    expect($plan)->not->toBeNull('the planner refused the defended neighbour');

    $generation = app(CandidateActionFactory::class)
        ->create(app(PlayerPerceptionBuilder::class)->build($this->currentUserId));
    $offered = array_map(static fn ($candidate): string => $candidate->type->name, $generation->candidates);
    expect(in_array('Raid', $offered, true))->toBeTrue('offered: ' . json_encode($offered) . ' rejections: ' . json_encode($generation->rejections));

    $situation->sessions(3)->expectMission('Attack');
});

test('a defenceless neighbour is still raided', function (): void {
    Situation::of($this)
        ->archetype(AiArchetype::Miner)
        ->resources(2_000_000, 2_000_000, 2_000_000)
        ->ships('large_cargo', 20)
        ->ships('light_fighter', 60)
        ->inactiveNeighbour(metal: 500_000, crystal: 300_000)
        ->spyReport()
        ->sessions(3)
        ->expectMission('Attack');
});

test('a neighbour that keeps a fleet is fought', function (): void {
    Situation::of($this)
        ->archetype(AiArchetype::Miner)
        ->resources(2_000_000, 2_000_000, 2_000_000)
        ->ships('large_cargo', 20)
        ->ships('light_fighter', 200)
        ->inactiveNeighbour(metal: 500_000, crystal: 300_000)
        ->neighbourUnits('light_fighter', 40)
        ->spyReport()
        ->sessions(3)
        ->expectMission('Attack');
});
